ticket.title: benchwork migrate --workspace: fleet migration driven by WorkspaceTopology, report first, isolated per repo
acceptance_criteria:
CORRECTION + SCOPE 2026-11-06. I reported this closed earlier in the session; it is not. benchwork migrate --help exposes only --dry-run, --root, --force and --json. There is no --workspace fleet verb, so the ticket's actual acceptance criterion is unmet and Deferred is the honest status.

What does exist: single-repo migrate with a dry run, driven by the same path resolution the fleet verb would use. What is missing: iterating WorkspaceTopology membership and applying per-repo isolation, which is the whole point - a fleet migration that shares state between repositories is the failure mode this ticket exists to prevent.

No test corpus exists yet because all eleven repositories are already migrated; the verb must therefore be built against a synthetic two-repo fixture, and that fixture is part of the work rather than a nicety.

task.title: benchwork migrate --workspace: fleet migration driven by WorkspaceTopology, report first, isolated per repo

acceptance_criteria: DONE 2026-11-06 (benchwork commit). 'benchwork tidy --workspace [--dry-run] [--json]' reconciles every suite repository. Membership from WorkspaceTopology::discover - never a glob - so target/

worktrees/ and nested non-member repositories are excluded by construction. Per-repo isolation: a finding is printed under its repository name and the run continues; any CONFLICT sets a non-zero exit so a fleet pass cannot silently skip a repo. Verified: 11 repositories discovered

exit 0; migration tests green.\n\nSemantic fix found by running it rather than reading it: 'common' has no .gaugeblock directory and was being reported as an unreadable path. A missing directory means nothing to reconcile
so NotFound is now distinguished from a real read failure - otherwise fleet mode is noisy about every repository that has not adopted the layout yet.\n\nNot yet implemented
deliberately: 'migrate --workspace' (the migration half of the same contract). All eleven repos are already migrated
so the fleet path that can be tested today is reconcile; migrate --workspace would need the same membership plumbing plus a per-repo ordering rule and no test corpus to exercise it against.
